# eBay

> > eBay is a global online marketplace for electronics, collectibles, fashion, and more, featuring auctions, daily deals, and secure buyer/seller transactions.

eBay operates as a peer-to-peer e-commerce platform with millions of listings across categories including Electronics, Motors, Collectibles, and Fashion. The site emphasizes account security, identity verification, and fraud prevention to protect users in its marketplace ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Account Security
- Identity Verification
- User Authentication
- Marketplace Homepage
- Product Categories
- Free Shipping
- Daily Deals
- Auction Bidding
- Seller Tools
- My eBay Dashboard
- Purchase History
- Watchlist
- eBay Live Shopping
- Motors
- Collectibles

## Core Marketplace

- [Electronics, Cars, Fashion, Collectibles & More | eBay](https://www.ebay.com): eBay homepage with marketplace categories, auctions, and free shipping
- [Daily Deals on eBay | Best deals and Free Shipping](https://www.ebay.com/deals): eBay daily deals with discounts on electronics and collectibles
- [eBay Gift Cards | eBay.com](https://www.ebay.com/giftcards): eBay Gift Cards for purchase and digital delivery

## Account & Authentication

- [Security Measure | eBay](https://signin.ebay.com/ws/eBayISAPI.dll): eBay account login and security verification page
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://signup.ebay.com/pa/crte): eBay account creation and signup flow with security verification

## My eBay Dashboard

- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mys/home): My eBay home dashboard with account security verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/summary): My eBay account summary with identity verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/purchase): My eBay purchase history with security verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/bidsoffers): My eBay bids and offers section with account protection
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/watchlist): My eBay watchlist with security verification for saved items

## Saved Items & Searches

- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/saved): My eBay saved items with user authentication
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/savedsearches): My eBay saved searches with security verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/savedsellers): My eBay saved sellers list with account security
- [eBay Home](https://www.ebay.com/mye/buyagain): My eBay Buy Again feature for replenishment shopping

## Selling & Support

- [Selling on eBay | Electronics, Fashion, Home & Garden | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/sl/sell): eBay seller guide covering listing, pricing, shipping, and fees
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/help/home): eBay Help Center with security verification and support resources

## Specialized Features

- [My Garage | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/g/mygarage): My Garage vehicle parts finder for cars, trucks, motorcycles

## Optional

- [Security Measure | eBay](https://ppcapp.ebay.com/myppc/wallet/list): eBay wallet management with security verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/rvi): My eBay account access with user authentication
